Execution failed due to significant numerical discrepancies in margin calculations and formatting mismatches in the final summary report.
The verifier failed with three major errors in test_outputs.py. In test_rows_and_order, a value mismatch occurred: close(468.0, 7956.0) returned False. In test_totals_and_decision, total_annual_margin_6_day_usd was -45894.84 instead of the expected -83406.84. Finally, test_summary_requirements failed because the summary text lacked required comma-formatted strings (e.g., '-45,894.84'), despite the raw values being present.
